pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with sharp, serrated pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is non-uniform, showing a gradient from larger, more complex shapes on the upper flank to smaller, more rectangular fragments on the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space pathways are cream-colored and form a continuous graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively wide on the mid-flank and narrows towards the distal portion of the limbs.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Presence of a large, dark, textured mass on the right dorsal-lateral ridge. The area exhibits significant textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation compared to surrounding pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, raised, irregular growth is visible on the upper right flank. Multiple small, dark punctate spots are visible on the posterior of the hind legs, suggesting localized skin disruptions or parasitic presence.
